Coursework Constraint: Student ID Prefix Rule
All 24 classifiers are prefixed with 2635746_ as specified by Kingston University assessment regulations.
Placeholder must be replaced by the candidate's actual Student ID prior to final coursework upload.
1 : 0..* One guest/room associated with 0 or more reservations.
1 : 0..1 One confirmed reservation generates at most 1 invoice.
1 : 1 Room composed with exactly 1 RoomType, BedType, Status.
{static} Class-level static constant or utility method
No artificial inheritance: Clean composition and enum domain patterns.
